title: Avocado Cucumber Sesame Uramaki
description: Fresh cucumber and creamy avocado with both white and black sesame.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Cut avocado and cucumber into neat batons. Brush avocado very lightly with lemon juice to slow browning.
Spread rice over a half-sheet of nori and scatter white and black sesame across the rice.
Flip rice-side-down on a wrapped mat; place avocado and cucumber on nori, then roll firmly.
Slice each roll into eight pieces and serve promptly.
notes: Dry cucumber thoroughly to keep the rice from becoming wet.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
